title: [MouseWithoutBorders] Add theme-adaptive system tray icon setting
author: JRScott812
summary: One localized suggestion keeps cursor and tray initialization running if WMI-backed theme monitoring cannot start. The unsafe shared-bitmap disposal claim and unsupported or optional earlier findings remain withdrawn.

status.label: One suggestion awaits approval
status.detail: One nonduplicate fail-open suggestion is grounded at current RIGHT line 738 and passed exact literal candidate validation.

next_action.label: Approve, edit, or hold the drafted COMMENT review
next_action.reason: The draft contains only the localized ThemeListener construction guard. Explicit maintainer approval and a final publisher freshness check are required before any upstream write.

proposed_comments.title: Keep tray setup running when theme monitoring fails

confidence.rationale: The constructor starts WMI watchers and can throw; direct current-head control flow shows the exception reaches FrmScreen_Load's outer catch before cursor creation and UpdateNotifyIcon, while the repository's Peek caller already catches the same constructor.

actions.label: Post the ThemeListener fail-open suggestion
actions.note: Draft only. The validation proves current control flow and compilation of the literal patch; no real WMI outage or system-theme change was induced.

phase0.processGates: CLA and current intake checks pass. The author supplied a Mouse Without Borders behavior video and reports a successful Settings build; no additional process request is proposed.

suggestion_patch.limitations: No real WMI failure, theme change, multi-PC session, or live settings reload was induced. Validation covers exact source control flow, repository precedent, uniform raw target EOL, diff integrity, and compilation of the verbatim minimal replacement.

withdrawn_findings.reason: ManagementEventWatcher has a finalizer that calls Stop(), so the abandoned watcher is eventually unwound. Explicit rollback is deterministic cleanup, but the retained persistent-subscription leak claim was not established.
Images.notify_default is a shared resource bitmap; unconditional disposal cannot be assumed safe.
Avoiding a registry read while adaptive icons are disabled is an optimization, not a demonstrated correctness defect.
The broad cross-module fan-out was removed from the converged fork and exact upstream consumer evidence did not support retaining the recovered claim.

new_upstream_findings.finding: ThemeListener construction failure skips remaining Mouse Without Borders form initialization

upstream_safety.detail: No write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.
